requirement: Every performance claim reports complete-SAB T_bootstrap/r and same-r scalar repeated baseline.
Paper-level performance promotion needs repeated runs and uncertainty; single perf-stat runs are attribution only.
Any new implementation must isolate representation, kernel, schedule, post-processing, and backend effects.
Each future variant must record commit, command, backend, CPU flags, seeds, raw logs, and artifact hashes.
Rejected and blocked candidates remain in the matrix and are not deleted from the research record.
